# ESARC

> We don't build AI slop. We use AI to move fast. ESARC is two senior engineers in Vancouver, Canada, building production AI products for startups and small teams across North America. Agent-built, partner-reviewed: AI agents write the code in parallel, and a partner reviews every change before it ships.

Last updated: 2026-10-19

ESARC is Vaibhav Malhotra (founder, principal engineer) and Bhimesh Chauhan (partner). We build AI agents and voice agents, search and answers over your data (RAG), and make existing AI reliable with evals, monitoring and cost control. We work remotely on Pacific time and reply within one business day.

## How to work with us

- [Free 30-minute call](https://esarc.dev/contact): Tell us what you want to build. We say honestly whether we're the right team.
- [Discovery week](https://esarc.dev/services#discovery): $2,500, one week. Turns your idea into a spec and a fixed quote. The fee is credited to your sprint.
- [4-week pilot sprint](https://esarc.dev/services#pilot-sprint): $18K-$24K fixed price. One AI feature or workflow in production with real users.
- [6-week MVP sprint](https://esarc.dev/services#mvp-sprint): $32K-$45K fixed price. A whole first version, live.
- [Monthly retainer](https://esarc.dev/services#build-partner): $5K, $11K or $19K per month. Keep shipping every week. Cancel with 6 weeks' notice.
- [Services and pricing](https://esarc.dev/services): The full offer, how an engagement runs, and FAQ.
- [AI ROI calculator](https://esarc.dev/roi): Estimate whether one workflow is worth automating. Uses your numbers, not our prices.

## Selected work

- [Stuf Storage: Sidney voice agent](https://esarc.dev/work/stuf-sidney-ai): Voice agent for self-storage sales calls. 150+ qualified leads at the industry's biggest trade show, 90% better lead-to-customer conversion, +25% demo success, 60% fewer fallback prompts.
- [Scrubs Co-Pilot](https://esarc.dev/work/scrubs-co-pilot): Structured clinical notes from recorded visits. 60% less time finishing documentation and 85% better documentation accuracy.
- [Wrangle](https://esarc.dev/work/wrangle): Consumer travel app built from zero by the two ESARC partners: mobile app, API and AI photo pipeline. Bhimesh Chauhan leads the build.
- [MyMethod](https://esarc.dev/work/mymethod): Multi-tenant voice agents on Vapi, with eval-gated releases and call transcripts in Supabase.
- [Springhouse](https://esarc.dev/work/springhouse): Multi-agent meal-planning backend on Pydantic AI, FastAPI and Postgres.
- [Meta Superintelligence Labs](https://esarc.dev/work/meta-superintelligence): Tool calling, MCP integration and agent evaluation for conversational AI. Details under NDA.
- [Amazon](https://esarc.dev/work/amazon-shipping-ai): Services in Amazon's shipping cost path.
- [McGraw Hill](https://esarc.dev/work/mcgraw-hill): AI engineering for an education publisher. Details under NDA.
- [All work](https://esarc.dev/work)
